# dsh-tool-cards
中文 | English
## 中文
**为 DeepSeek Harness 提供交互式聊天卡片。**
在一条助手消息内直接渲染滑块、下拉、分段控件、日期选择器、表单、图表和表格——用户按下提交按钮后，参数快照会作为新消息回传给智能体。

> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `chat-ui/1.0` 消息格式的独立实现，不是任何官方 ChatGPT 协议，也不复现任何私有实现。
### 它做什么
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### 为什么卡片要被"提升"
`chat_ui` 是一次工具调用，而工具结果通常属于 *process* 区段——模型思考结束后 DSH 会把这一段折叠起来，卡片也会跟着消失。所以 client 端注册了一个由 `tool/res
ult` 事件驱动的自定义聊天节点（`chat-ui-card`），锚定到会话输出流上；工具行则降级为一行占位符加一个原始数据展开。
如果 `uiConversation` 不可用，插件会回退为在工具行内渲染卡片，功能仍然可用。
### 组件
共 26 种注册组件：
| 分组 | 类型 |

| 输入 | `Slider` `Checkbox` `Radio` `Select` `Segmented` `Input` `Textarea` `Date` `Button` |
| 容器 |

`Form` `Pressable` `Popover` `Carousel` |
| 视觉 | `Chart`（柱/线/饼/散点）`Map` |
| 展示 | `Card` `Metric` `Te
xt` `Heading` `Row` `Column` `Divider` `Badge` `Alert` `Table` `KeyValue` |
表达式使用白名单 JSON AST——`{ op: "mul", args: [{ var: "a" }, { var: "b" }] }`，支持 `add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div`/`r
ound`/`eq`/`and`/`or`/`not`。**没有 eval，不生成代码。**
### 安装
[代码示例省略，未执行]
或在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 中手动加入 bundle 行：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
然后重启 DSH（profile patch 在启动时读取）。
### 用法
`chat_ui` 工具会出现在模型的工具集里。它的描述告诉模型何时使用它（调参数、多维对比、"给我做个计算器"），何时不该用（纯解释、一次性结论）。
最小载荷示例：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Action 类型：`submitToAgent`、`callTool`、`openUrl`（仅 http/https）。
### 按钮与文案约定

- 提交按钮是卡片**唯一的出口**：全宽、加粗、上方有分隔线。
- 按钮文案描述**用户的下一个动作**，由模型按当前任务决定——"应用这组参数""计算推荐投加量""提交这次配比"。
### 限制
每条消息：≤ 120 个节点，树深度 ≤ 8，≤ 60 个状态键，≤ 20 个 action，文本 ≤ 4000 字符。由 host 强制执行，畸形载荷在到达 client 前就会被拒绝。
### 说明与注意事项

- `Chart` 和 `Map` 是手绘 SVG。`Map` 只做坐标投影示意，不连接任何瓦片服务。
- client bundle 将 `react` 保持为 external（由 host 提供

），内联了 `@json-render/*` 和 `zod`，因为它们不在平台模块基线里。
- 样式只使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，自动跟随亮/暗主题。

## English
**Interactive chat cards for DeepSeek Harness.**

Render sliders, selects, segmented controls, date pickers, forms, charts and tables **inside an
assi

stant message** — then send the resulting parameter snapshot back to the agent when the user
presses

hen send the resulting parameter snapshot back to the agent when the user
presses the submit button.

> [!NOTE]
> This is a standalone implementation of the `chat-ui/1.0` message format. It is not an of

ficial
> ChatGPT protocol and does not reproduce any private implementation.
### What it does
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Why the card is "promoted"

`chat_ui` is a tool call, and tool results normally belong to the *process* section, which DSH
colla

pses once the model finishes thinking — taking the card with it. So the client registers a
custom ch

at node (`chat-ui-card`) driven by the `tool/result` event and anchors it to the session
output stre
am. The tool row degrades to a one-line placeholder plus a raw-data disclosure.
If `uiConversation` is unavailable, the plugin falls back to rendering the card inside the tool row,
so the feature still works.
### Action ownership (security)

The client **never** says which session an action belongs to. At execute time the host records
`card

→ session` and hands the client an opaque `cardToken` through `presentationMeta`; the action
route
accepts only that token and ignores any `sessionId` in the request body.

An earlier version trusted `body.sessionId` and resolved it with `agents.get()`, which let any
same-

origin page inject a user message into *any* session. `tools/security-test.mjs` now pins the
behavio

r: forged `sessionId` → 403, unknown token → 403, valid token + forged session → routed to
the token
's own session, released session → 409.

If the host cannot determine the owner session, the tool issues no token and the card renders
read-o
nly — it never guesses a target.

| Inputs | `Slider` `Checkbox` `Radio` `Select` `Segmented` `Input` `Textarea` `Date` `Button` |

| Visuals | `Chart` (bar/line/pie/scatter) `Ma

p` |
| Display | `Card` `Metric` `Text` `Heading` `Row` `Column` `Divider` `Badge` `Alert` `Table` `
lay | `Card` `Metric` `Text` `Heading` `Row` `Column` `Divider` `Badge` `Alert` `Table` `KeyValue` |
[该节后续省略]
### Notes and caveats

- `Chart` and `Map` are hand-drawn SVG. `Map` projects coordinates only for illustration and does
no

t connect to any tile service.
- The client bundle keeps `react` external (the host provides it) and

inlines `@json-render/*`
and `zod`, because those are not on the platform module baseline.
- Stylin
g uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so it follows light/dark automatically.
